title: Constraints on high-J CO emission lines in z ∼ 6 quasars
question: What are the dust properties and high-J CO line luminosities of two z~6 quasars (J2310, J1319), and how do their CO SLEDs compare with J1148 and local AGN/starbursts, constraining gas heating mechanisms?

what.value: Continuum flux densities of J2310 and J1319 at other frequencies (incl. band 8)

evidence.quote: Col.(j) reference; [1] (cite: Feruglio:2018) [2] (cite: Wang:2013) [3] (cite: Wang:2011) [4] (cite: Hashimoto:2018a).

what.value: J1148 continuum flux densities for SED fit

evidence.quote: We retrieve from the literature all flux continuum densities (cite: Bertoldi:2003; Walter:2003; Riechers:2009; Cicone:2015)

what.value: Literature CO line luminosities (CO(6-5), CO(2-1), etc.) for SLEDs

external_data.citation: Shao:2019; Feruglio:2018; Wang:2013; Bertoldi:2003a; Stefan:2015; Walter:2003; Riechers:2009; Gallerani:2014

what.value: Average local AGN and starburst CO SLEDs

evidence.quote: averaged CO(6-5)-normalised CO SLEDs from low-$z$ starburst galaxies and AGN, respectively (cite: Rosenberg:2015; Mashian:2015; Mingozzi:2018)

what.value: Dust mass absorption coefficient k_nu=0.45 (nu/250 GHz)^beta cm2/g

evidence.quote: we assume k$_{\nu}$ = 0.45$\times(\nu$/250 GHz)$^{\beta}$ cm$^{2}$ g$^{-1}$ (cite: Beelen:2006)
adopting the PDR/XDR models by (cite: Meijerink:2005) and (cite: Meijerink:2007)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image continuum and cubes
recipe.method: CASA calibration; tclean natural weighting; uvcontsub continuum subtraction
Sersic profile (n=1) fit to visibilities with GALARIO and emcee
key_parameters: 40 walkers; priors p(log Ie)=U(-5,1), p(log Re)=U(-2,0), p(i)=U(0,90) deg, p(PA)=U(180,360) deg

recipe.goal: Fit dust SED for Mdust, Tdust, beta, LFIR
recipe.method: CMB-corrected modified blackbody with finite optical depth, MCMC over Mdust, Tdust, beta
key_parameters: uniform priors, 30 K<Tdust<90 K, 1.0<beta<2.0; 50 chains, 3000 trials
assumptions: k_nu = 0.45 (nu/250 GHz)^beta cm2/g; T0=2.73 K; solid angle from fitted continuum size

recipe.goal: Measure CO line fluxes and upper limits
recipe.method: Integrate cubes; 3 sigma upper limits in 1.4''x1.4'' aperture with width 400 (J2310) or 500 (J1319) km/s

recipe.goal: Build and compare CO SLEDs and interpret with PDR/XDR models
recipe.method: CO(6-5)- and LFIR-normalised SLEDs compared with local AGN/starbursts and z~6 quasars; PDR/XDR models for J2310

evidence.quote: characterized by a density ${\rm n\sim4\times10^{5} \ cm^{-3}}$

not_stated_but_needed: Cleaning thresholds, masks, cell and image sizes
Flux calibrator and flux scale uncertainty
Exact PDR/XDR model grid parameters and fitting procedure for J2310
Priors/limits on size and flux in the SED fit's solid angle treatment (adopted sizes for J1148)
Adopted velocity range for line flux integration of CO(8-7)/(9-8)
missing_for_reproduction: CASA version, imaging parameters, line-free channels
score_reason: Data public and fitting approach described with priors, but imaging and calibration details and some inputs are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric continuum sizes, dust properties, and line luminosities with described recipe.
